basics.name: Naiem Sheikh
basics.label: PhD Student in Geography · Remote Sensing and Precision Agriculture
basics.summary: I specialize in remote sensing and GIS applications in agriculture, applying machine learning and deep learning to geospatial analysis. My work integrates UAS and satellite imagery with in-situ and weather data to improve crop monitoring, yield prediction, and sustainable land management across agroecosystems.

work.name: Department of Geography, Oklahoma State University
work.summary: Investigating the impacts of climate and management practices on agroecosystems in the Southern Great Plains using remote sensing and in-situ observations.
highlights: Collect and process multispectral, RGB, and thermal UAS imagery over irrigated corn field experiments
Develop machine learning models fusing UAS-derived spectral and thermal features with weather data for yield prediction
Evaluate model generalization across seasons, management practices, and climatic variability
Conduct field campaigns at USDA-managed research sites in Oklahoma
